verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships an official MCP server, so users can drive their workspace in natural language through an external AI assistant that acts as them, limited to their role. Fieldwork also takes a plain-language control description and has AI agents collect the evidence. Natural-language operation still depends on a third-party assistant rather than a native command interface. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which MCP tools/actions are exposed, and independent or hands-on corroboration of NL-driven operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: add the Oneleet MCP server to your assistant, and it opens a browser window where you log in to Oneleet, review what the assistant is asking for, and pick the workspace it should work in.
Once connected, the assistant acts as you. It can only see and do what your own role in the workspace allows, every action is attributed to your account
Describe your control. Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
